name: plimsoll
description: Run Python or JavaScript in a plimsoll sandbox: the output, the isolation tier it ran behind, and the run record the client checked

daemon_url.title: plimsolld URL
daemon_url.description: The plimsoll daemon the code runs on, such as http://127.0.0.1:8080. Cleartext HTTP is accepted only to this machine.

token.title: plimsolld caller token
token.description: A caller token with the code:run scope, created with plimsoll-clients. Kept in secure storage, not in settings.json.

min_isolation.title: Weakest isolation tier accepted
min_isolation.description: kernel (a verified gVisor runtime) unless you choose otherwise; container for a plain docker daemon, which does not keep hostile code off your kernel.
